mentions.name: LLM local library book recommender
mentions.description: This tool uses LLMs to recommend books the user can borrow from their local library, drawing on the model's latent knowledge of books it has 'read' and a conversation about books the user has liked.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been playing around with using llms to recommend me books I can get from my local library based on the model’s latent knowledge of books it has ‘read’ and a conversation with it about books I’ve liked.
mentions.author: kidnoodle
